title: Joint Stars synthetic aperture radar proven in Desert Storm
summary: Greg Rogers tells of Joint Stars synthetic aperture radar proven in Desert Storm, about c. 1980s–1991 at Saudi Arabia / Desert Storm theater, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: This one shows, hey, we did this in Desert Storm. And uh after Joint Stars was demonstrated in Desert Storm, we decided we will never go into combat without the synthetic aperture radar that was developed by uh Joystars.

plain: Greg Rogers, a man who says he worked on government technology projects, says he was involved with Joint Stars, an aircraft radar system developed in the 1980s. He says it used synthetic aperture radar, a kind of radar that builds detailed pictures of the ground, and that after it proved itself in Desert Storm, the 1991 Gulf War, the military decided never to go into combat without it. He tells it to show the kind of secret work he says he was part of.
